# macos-agent-bootstrap
> Interactive AI agent playbook (AGENTS.md) and minimal dotfiles to set up a fresh macOS development environment without bloat.

## Core Files
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): The main interactive setup playbook for AI coding agents.
- [Brewfile](Brewfile): The minimal core Homebrew bundle (Ghostty, Starship, Neovim, Zsh plugins).
- [catalog/optional-packages.md](catalog/optional-packages.md): Curated recipes for optional tools (uv, gh, node, go, cloud, containers).
- [scripts/audit.sh](scripts/audit.sh): Non-destructive read-only system audit script that outputs current macOS environment status.

## Dotfile Templates
- [dotfiles/zshrc](dotfiles/zshrc): Clean Zsh config with IDE/agent terminal detection to prevent prompt hangs.
- [dotfiles/starship.toml](dotfiles/starship.toml): Fast 2-line prompt configuration.
- [dotfiles/ghostty/config](dotfiles/ghostty/config): Native macOS Ghostty configuration.
- [dotfiles/nvim/init.vim](dotfiles/nvim/init.vim): Lightweight, zero-plugin Neovim configuration.
- [dotfiles/git/gitconfig.template](dotfiles/git/gitconfig.template): Sanitized single- or multi-account Git config.
- [dotfiles/ssh/config.template](dotfiles/ssh/config.template): Sanitized SSH config over Port 443 with macOS Keychain support.
